# htopQt tooling notice

[LICENSE](LICENSE) retains the project notice from htopQt at commit
`f57b93a72d765f738a6b779b4b3c94e16c0ef64a`, repository
<https://github.com/Feverqwe/htop-qt-ai-driven.git>.
The notice's `third_party/htop/COPYING` path belongs to that source project;
this repository retains the GPL version 2 text at
[third_party/linux/LICENSES/preferred/GPL-2.0](../linux/LICENSES/preferred/GPL-2.0).

This notice applies to the borrowed tooling and its adaptations, not to all
Sevenzip sources. Import scope and adaptations are described in
[CI and packaging](../../docs/ci.md) and
[Hyper-V runner provenance](../../docs/hyperv-runners.md#runner-configuration-and-evidence).
The release/packaging import was recorded in Sevenzip commit
`f91e0c010c35d239b6a179ebc462df24d842eb3f` and the restored release workflow in
`52c0b3e7205a78ac6aa7efcf8ec11dbc8e179a4e`; runner provenance
includes mixed revisions and a modified source worktree as recorded there.
